sources.title: GitHub - Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-MT2
sources.snippet: Model Introduction Hy-MT2 is a family of "fast-thinking" multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages.

sources.title: Hy MT2 7B by Tencent — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A multilingual specialist with an unusually long memory — its 262K token context window lets it hold entire documents, codebases, or lengthy conversations without losing track. Built by Tencent, it handles text-in, text-out tasks with a focus on translation and cross-lingual understanding. At 7B parameters, it stays lean enough to run locally while punching above its weight on language tasks.
